definitions.rates: Sum numerators and exposure denominators before computing rates; never average match percentages. Shots/10 in-play minutes uses the common match in-play exposure once, even when both teams shots are pooled.
definitions.ends: Terminal event labels are distinct from evidence co-occurrences. Shot releases end an episode; a same-team rebound may begin another. Retained restarts are not possession losses. Pending/censored episodes are separate from failures.
definitions.ordered: Strict first-milestone paths use confirmed actual gain origins, separated by initial pressure/screen eligibility. Order-incompatible milestones are resolved only for that strict first-observed path, not a claim that the live attack failed or cannot re-enter a region.
definitions.coverage: Natural event opportunities are not controlled scenario success or keeper quality rates.

observerDefinitions.attack: An episode starts on an actual successful acquire, actual restart release or an already active possession at attachment. A physical shot release ends the episode; a same-team rebound control starts another episode. New opponent control or a dead ball also ends it. Window/match end is right-censored, not failure.
observerDefinitions.control: Acquire is a contact/intention, recorded separately from settled control. Confirmation requires at least 0.15 continuous sampled seconds with ball centre gap<=1.45m and height<=0.65m (or hands), or an actual release. Aerial contact is confirmed physical contact, not a settled ground reception.
observerDefinitions.zones: Team-relative physical ball position, never a commanded destination. Final third begins at 52/3m; box begins at 35.5m and |z|<=20.16m. A sampled zone needs 0.15 continuous controlled seconds; actual release/header contact qualifies immediately. An episode starting inside a zone is labelled at-start and excluded from that zone progression denominator.
observerDefinitions.pressureEscape: Eligible only when a live opposing outfielder is within 4m at episode start. After confirmed control, keep the ball controlled with nearest rival>=5m for 0.5 continuous sampled seconds. No initial pressure is not-required, not a successful escape. This geometric pressure proxy is not the player perception model.
observerDefinitions.lineBreak: Operational proxy, not certified formation recognition: freeze at least two outfield rival IDs ahead of the physical origin (>=1m) within a 12m lateral band. At a later confirmed control/release, advance>=2m and be>=1m beyond both their frozen and current positions. The reference is refreshed from an actual pass release, not its planned destination.
observerDefinitions.clocks: Classify each observer.step interval from the state before the real step, using actual match time delta. Open-play windup, loose ball and goalkeeper holding are in play; placed restart windup and goal pause are dead. A boundary has at most one supplied step of classification uncertainty. Manual sample gaps over 0.05s are unobserved, not invented in-play time. Controlled, flight and loose bins partition in-play seconds.
observerDefinitions.evidence: Hold decisions/time, low-speed control, support commands/readiness by centre gap<=3m and box runner commands/arrivals are observed facts. They do not prove unnecessary waiting, a safe available pass, the best decision, or a causal tactical defect. No additional choose/passOptions/shotWindow/forecast query is made.
observerDefinitions.coverage: Natural counters measure actual processed windows and method/event outcomes. Descending cross windows and candidate reach are geometric samples; keeper processing opportunities are distinct keeperRead keys actually created by the engine. They are not all possible chances or quality ratings. Controlled scenario reports must remain separate.
observerDefinitions.truncation: Team aggregates retain every observed episode. maxEpisodes bounds detailed closed-episode and shot traces; dropped detail counts are explicit. Reading a report never ends an active episode.
